cc:Work.dc:title: Tray - DrillBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
A parametrized box for drills
![Multiple DrillBoxes](static/samples/DrillBoxes.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes DrillBox --sx 20:30 --sy '40*2' --sh 6:18 --bottom_edge F --top_edge t --holes 4 --firsthole 1.5 --holeincrement 0.25 --RoundedTriangleEdge_height 35 --RoundedTriangleEdge_outset 1 --thickness 4 --burn 0.05 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes DrillBox --sx --sy --sh --bottom_edge --top_edge --holes --firsthole --holeincrement --RoundedTriangleEdge_height --thickness --burn --reference --labels
